# HotspotEmergenceModeling

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Modeling the birth and evolution of crash hotspots as a dynamic process rather than static snapshots. Captures transient risk patterns, enabling adaptive network responses in time-sensitive TCC/iNEST deployments.
